title: FieldPoly integration docs + bench consolidation
description:
Close-out task for the `bdf95060` story: consolidate module documentation and bench harness.

## Scope

- Module-level docstring in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs` enumerates every operation with complexity, mirroring the table in `batch_ops.rs`.
- Consolidated bench harness `crates/gf2-core/benches/field_poly.rs`: `batch_evaluate` vs naive Horner (from Tasks 1/3), `interpolate_fast` vs quadratic `interpolate` (from Task 4), `mul_ntt` vs Karatsuba (from Task 7). Regenerate tables; paste them into the module docstring.
- Short overview `dev/plans/field_poly_module_overview.md` linking each API to its algorithmic reference.

## Scope removed (2026-04-19, SSOT override)

The previously-scoped "narrow integration helper `gf2m_poly_to_field_poly(&Gf2mPoly) -> FieldPoly<Gf2mElement>`" bullet is **removed**. Under the SSOT override, `Gf2mPoly_<V>` is fully retired or becomes a type alias for `FieldPoly<Gf2mElement_<V>>` as part of `70972f06`'s closing rework, so no cross-type conversion helper is needed.

## Success criteria

- `cargo test --workspace --all-features --release` ≤ 60s (CLAUDE.md rule). If this task pushes budget, move long proptests behind `#[ignore]`.
- All three gates pass: `code-review`, `doc-review`, `cargo-ci`.
- Module docstring enumerates every public operation with its complexity.
- Bench harness produces tables for all three comparisons listed above.
